hero.heading: Precision audio editing in your browser
hero.subheading: Trim, compress, transcribe, and export studio-ready audio without leaving your tab.

features.title: Lossless trimming & conversion
features.description: Cut and convert between MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC, and more using ffmpeg.wasm with zero backend latency.

features.title: Smart file intelligence
features.description: Automatically split oversized uploads into seamless segments and apply lossless compression to shrink transfer size.

features.title: AI subtitles & transcripts
features.description: Generate multilingual transcripts and subtitle files with Whisper-level accuracy directly in the editor.

features.title: Silence detection
features.description: Detect pauses and quiet zones to accelerate dialogue cleanup and podcast editing.

workflow.title: From upload to publish in minutes
steps: Upload audio or video via drag & drop.
Visualize the waveform, trim, split, and normalize levels.
Detect silences, auto-generate subtitles, and tweak metadata.
Export in your preferred format or download SRT/VTT files.

faq.question: How large can my files be?
faq.answer: Files up to 2 GB are optimized in-browser; larger uploads are auto-split into manageable chunks.

faq.question: Is my audio processed securely?
faq.answer: Everything runs locally in your browser unless you enable optional cloud backups.
